# DANZUS

> DANZUS Holdings LLC, in Folsom, California, builds websites and sets up local
> search and missed-call text-back for small businesses in Sacramento, Folsom,
> Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby. Missed-call text-back is $99 a month
> after a free 30-day pilot, with no setup fee, month to month. That is the
> founding client price. A website is $1,500 one time, plus $49 a month for
> hosting and small edits. Paid 50% up front and 50% at launch. The client keeps
> the site. Google and AI search is $199 a month. DANZUS Growth is $299 a month
> for text-back, Google and AI search, and hosting. With a 6-month commitment,
> the website is $750. Owner: Dan Johnson.
> Call or text (916) 404-6129. Email dan@danzus.co.
> LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/danjohnsondata

## Service area

Sacramento, Folsom, Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby.

## Services

- Missed-call text-back: a text goes back when a call is missed. $99 a month after a free 30-day pilot. No setup fee. Month to month. Founding client price.
- Website: a custom site for one local business, fast on a phone, built so the next step is a call or a lead. $1,500 one time, plus $49 a month for hosting and small edits. Paid 50% up front and 50% at launch. The client keeps the site.
- Google and AI search: Google Business Profile, local SEO, schema, an llms.txt file, and pages so the business can be described in Google and in AI answers such as ChatGPT and Perplexity. $199 a month.
- DANZUS Growth: missed-call text-back, Google and AI search, and hosting. $299 a month. With a 6-month commitment, the website is $750.
- Lead to Booked Job: a new inquiry becomes a time on the calendar.
- Quote to Cash: an estimate becomes money in the account.
- Job Closeout: a finished job leaves a review and a referral.
- Back Office: the inbox, the bills, and the week land in one place.
- Customer Service: the customer gets an answer, a status, or a person.

The assistant uses the calendar, QuickBooks, a CRM, and the texting the shop already has. A person signs off on anything risky before it reaches a customer.

## Prices

- Missed-call text-back: $99 a month after a free 30-day pilot. No setup fee. Month to month. Founding client price.
- Website: $1,500 one time, plus $49 a month for hosting and small edits. Paid 50% up front and 50% at launch. The client keeps the site.
- Google and AI search: $199 a month.
- DANZUS Growth: $299 a month for missed-call text-back, Google and AI search, and hosting. With a 6-month commitment, the website is $750.
